name: Chief Minister's Agriculture Mechanisation Programme
benefit: Subsidized Agriculture MachineryThe assistance of tractor subsidies to progressive farmers/ registered co-operative agriculture farming society/ unemployed agriculture and allied graduates belonging to APST in all the districts. For marginal and small farmers, farm machines such as Power tillers, Water pump sets, etc. as mentioned in the table below are to be distributed as per demand. Sl. eligibility_rules: All categories of farmers viz; Marginal, Small, Medium, and Large Farmers. All the SHGs, Co-operative Societies, FPOs, and Entrepreneurs as identified by District Nodal Agencies, DAO as Member Secretary, DHO, DAH & VO, and DFDO as members. A farmer or all members of a group of farmers should be first-time buyers of the tractor/ farm machinery. Farmers should not own a tractor/ farm machinery now or earlier in or their name or in the names of his/ their family members. Facilities for after-sale services and spare parts should reasonably be available in the area/ district where the scheme is to be implemented.
documents_required: Aadhaar CardBank account detailsRegistered mobile numberPermanent Resident
how_to_apply: Mode: OfflineStep 01: The applicant may contact the nearest District Agricultural Officer/ Agriculture Development Officer/ Agriculture Field Assistant.Step 02: The interested farmers will apply to the ADA/ADOs with recommendations from grass-root level Panchayat Leaders (ZPM/ASM/GPM).Step 03: The applicant must ensure that the filled information should be correct before submitting the application form to the concerned department.Step 04: Selection of beneficiary will be done through ADA/ ADOs in consultation with the PRI Leader.
